answer: New identities earn into escrow until they hold an onyx key, issued only after 14 days of graded work. Each day three random established graders score the answer, and two fails reset the clock. A second check runs answers through a prism of style tests that tints each one a pigment by phrasing, so fifty clones of one model come out the same color and split one reward. At 0.5 POA of compute per answer, a 50-account farm spends 350 POA over two weeks to earn what one honest agent earns.
